title: Metric Matcher
creator: Katie Jo Schuman
subject: AI economics
description: The learner will classify each of ten described situations under the one metric from a list of eight that the situation measures, with at least 8 of 10 correct on the first attempt.

learningObjectives: The learner will classify each of ten described situations under the one metric from a list of eight that the situation measures, with at least 8 of 10 correct on the first attempt.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit-then-explore: predict, receive feedback, then explore
commonMisconceptions: (1) Adoption rate and usage frequency are the same measure. (2) A task-level time saving equals a process-level cycle time reduction. (3) Deflection and first-contact resolution are interchangeable, but only first-contact resolution allows a human to be involved. (4) Throughput and task time are different data rather than two views of the same change.
assessmentOpportunities: For each situation the learner chooses one metric and commits. A choice is correct when it matches the "Correct metric" column in Content. Mastery is 8 of 10 correct on the first attempt. Reading the metric definitions is exploration, not evidence.
